verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents an OAuth 2.0 API that can access card and bank statements and update and reconcile transactions, plus category, cost-center and supplier endpoints. An agent could therefore read transactions and write categorizations back. However, nothing shows filtering for uncoded transactions, policy flags, a review/approval queue for agent-pushed coding, or an MCP server. LLM-friendly docs (llms.txt, Markdown pages) help agent builders, but no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: uncoded-transaction filter, policy-flag API, review workflow for pushed coding, MCP server, public OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration.
